modmenu.descriptionTranslation.numbyhack: Numby Hack - A Meteor addon with various utility modules.
module.meteor-client.auto-log+.descripti: Disconnects you when a specific condition is reached.
module.meteor-client.BetterPlace.descrip: Helps you place blocks where you normally can't.
module.meteor-client.bonemeal-aura.descr: Automatically bonemeal crops around the player.
module.meteor-client.carpet-placer.descr: Helps with manual carpet placing for spawn proofing and mapart.
module.meteor-client.chat-encryption.des: Encrypts messages using a user-provided key.
module.meteor-client.confetti.descriptio: Changes the color of the totem pop particles.
module.meteor-client.log-spots-+.descrip: Displays a box where another player has logged out at.
module.meteor-client.new-chunks.descript: Detects completely new chunks using certain traits of them.
module.meteor-client.packet-delay.descri: Allows you to delay the packets you send to a server.
module.meteor-client.ride-stats.descript: Displays information above rideable entity's heads.
module.meteor-client.safe-fire.descripti: Prevents you from walking into fire.
module.meteor-client.safety-net.descript: Places a block under you at a set Y level.
module.meteor-client.sculk-range-esp.des: Draws a range indicator around the activation range of sculk sensors.
module.meteor-client.shield-swap.descrip: Automatically swaps a shield into your offhand.
module.meteor-client.sign-text-esp.descr: Shows you the text on signs from far away.
module.meteor-client.spawner-esp.descrip: Shows spawners of different mobs in different colors.
module.meteor-client.egap-finder.descrip: Finds Enchanted Golden Apples in chests and logs coordinates.
module.meteor-client.tnt-fuse-esp.descri: Shows the fuse time of lit tnt.
command.meteor-client.coordinate-convert: Converts coordinates to opposite dimensions (ow/end <-> nether).
module.meteor-client.lava-warning.descri: Warns you when there is lava under you.
module.meteor-client.text-radar.descript: Displays players and their stats in your visual range.
